[[Luxon Ritualist]]s are members of the [[Luxon|Luxon Armada]] that support their team with [[binding ritual|spirits]] and [[Restoration Magic]]. They are allied to players in Jade Sea, and hostile when encountered in the Echovald Forest.

**{{NPC location|Ferndale}} (only during [[Kurzick Supply Lines]] and [[Scouting Ferndale]])
**{{NPC location|Melandru's Hope}} (only during [[Securing Echovald Forest]])
